MATCH (o:Owner)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT o
MATCH (o)-[r:Owns]->(:Team)
WITH o, r,
     date_diff('year', date(o.birth_date), date('2026-10-14')) -
     CASE
       WHEN date_part('month', date(o.birth_date)) * 100 + date_part('day', date(o.birth_date)) > 1014 THEN 1
       ELSE 0
     END AS owner_age
WHERE owner_age <= 76
   OR o.name = 'Joseph Chung-Hsin Tsai'
   OR CAST(r.since_year AS INT64) > 2013
   OR o.nationality = 'American'
RETURN r.since_year AS col1, owner_age AS col2, o.nationality AS col3, o.name AS name_manager

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT o
MATCH (o)-[r:Owns]->(:Team)
WITH o, r,
  CASE
    WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN
      2026 - CAST(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) -
      CASE WHEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) * 100 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) > 1014 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ELSE
      2026 - CAST(REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, ',', 2), ' ', '') AS INT64) -
      CASE
        WHEN CASE SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, ' ', 1)
          WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3 WHEN 'April' THEN 4
          WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6 WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8
          WHEN 'September' THEN 9 WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 WHEN 'December' THEN 12
        END * 100 + CAST(REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, ' ', 2), ',', '') AS INT64)
        > 1014 THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END
  END AS owner_age
WHERE owner_age <= 76
   OR o.name = 'Joseph Chung-Hsin Tsai'
   OR CAST(r.since_year AS INT64) > 2013
   OR o.nationality = 'American'
RETURN r.since_year AS col1, owner_age AS col2, o.nationality AS col3, o.name AS name_manager
